name: smwgraphics-terranigma-hitoderon-gossie
title: Terranigma - Hitoderon & Gossie
description:
A complete rip of the background used in the battle of Hitoderon and Gossie, from Terranigma. Unlike the older version in the site, this one is the full background, no clever edits at all. This rip was part of my C3 Graphic Ripping Showcase .

(05/20/2022) MASSIVE UPDATE: Palette has been optimized. Better map 16. Optimized to use even less 8x8 tiles. Created some map 16 tiles for better looping.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
